title: Spanish Language – Level 04
overview: This intermediate Spanish course strengthens learners’ ability to communicate independently and accurately across familiar social, travel, and professional contexts. Building on Level 03, participants develop connected discourse, control of contrasting past tenses, emerging subjunctive forms, conditional expressions, and more confident comprehension of authentic spoken and written Spanish. Guided practice emphasizes meaningful interaction, intercultural awareness, and effective workplace communication.
audience: Learners who have completed Spanish Language – Level 03 or demonstrate comparable pre-intermediate competence and wish to progress toward independent intermediate-level communication for personal, academic, travel, or professional purposes.
methodology: Interactive trainer-led instruction with guided discovery of grammar in context.
Pair and group role-plays, problem-solving tasks, and scenario-based conversations.
Authentic and adapted audio, reading materials, short videos, and structured writing practice.
Pronunciation coaching, targeted feedback, formative quizzes, and an integrated final performance task.
competencies: Sustain connected conversations, narrate events, and justify preferences and decisions.
Use a wider range of tenses, pronouns, connectors, and conditional structures with increasing accuracy.
Understand the main ideas and relevant details of moderately complex speech and texts.
Write organized messages, narratives, and professional correspondence appropriate to audience and purpose.
Handle common workplace exchanges and intercultural situations with confidence.
objectives: Differentiate and apply pretérito indefinido, imperfecto, and pretérito perfecto in meaningful narratives.
Express hypotheses, polite requests, future intentions, and advice using appropriate structures.
Recognize and practice common uses of the present subjunctive in opinions, wishes, and recommendations.
Participate in discussions, give explanations, and present information using cohesive language.
Interpret intermediate-level reading and listening texts and produce clear connected written responses.
Demonstrate integrated listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills in realistic scenarios.
